Container.Name: Typr-Companion
Container.Overview: Optional native LaTeX, TeXpresso, and scoped workspace service for Typr. Stateless by default; one dedicated workspace can be mapped explicitly. Trusted LAN/VPN use only; never expose it publicly.
Container.Description: Typr Companion is installed separately from the browser-local Typr PWA. It runs native latexmk/pdfLaTeX and experimental TeXpresso behind a fail-closed Landlock launcher. Browser projects remain authoritative. Administrators may optionally map one exact read/write directory for explicit manual sync; no broad share or appdata root belongs here. The service is unauthenticated, so all users and documents must be trusted and it must never be exposed to the public Internet.
Container.Changes: 2026-08-10: Match tested container hardening and add the optional exact-workspace configuration.
Container.Requires: Use only on a trusted LAN or private VPN. Never expose this unauthenticated service to the public Internet. Remote browser use requires a client-trusted HTTPS reverse proxy with WebSocket support and firewall/VPN restriction. The host kernel must support Landlock or the container fails closed.

Config.Name: Companion port
Config.Description: Host port used by the reverse proxy and local status checks. Container port must remain 8484.

Config.Name: Allowed Typr origins
Config.Description: Comma-separated exact browser origins, including scheme, host, and port with no path or trailing slash. Add the self-hosted Typr origin. CORS is not authentication.

Config.Name: Workspace directory
Config.Description: Optional one exact dedicated project directory. Never map /, /mnt, /mnt/user, a broad share, appdata root, symlinked root, or the Docker socket. UID 1000 needs read/write access.

Config.Name: Workspace API root
Config.Description: Set exactly /workspace only when Workspace directory is configured. Leave blank to disable the file API.

Config.Name: Workspace ID
Config.Description: Stable opaque letters/numbers/dot/underscore/hyphen identifier for browser bindings; never put a host path here. Ignored while the API root is blank.
